title: Critique: a necessitarian Russellian monism is coherent but unmotivated

statements.text: If the phenomenal aspect of a quiddity metaphysically necessitates its causal profile, Howell grants that the exclusion argument fails. But accepting necessities that hold despite conceivability concedes what type-B physicalists and property dualists need, so a necessitarian version loses the reason for adopting the view.

sources.quote: Given this, necessitarian Russellian Monism might be conceptually coherent, but it is unmotivated.
